title: Video Streaming
subtitle: Cut it into chunks, cache the chunks, and protect the origin
motto: Nobody streams from your servers; they stream from the nearest copy
coreAddition: transcoding, chunked adaptive bitrate and a CDN with a shield tier
keyInsight: A CDN hit rate is a percentage but the origin lives on absolute load, so a 10x audience needs another tier, not just a good hit rate.

decisions.title: Fail at 10x with the hit rate unchanged
decisions.description: The failure frame keeps the CDN hit rate constant and multiplies traffic, to show that the origin sees the miss volume and not the miss percentage.
decisions.alternatives: Dropping the hit rate would blame the cache for a problem that the traffic growth alone causes.

decisions.title: Fix it with a shield tier, and price the second tier
decisions.description: The trade-off frame adds a regional cache in front of the origin and reports the extra tier next to the lower origin load.
decisions.alternatives: Adding origin capacity would work at 10x but leaves the next multiple unsolved, and storing fewer qualities would give up adaptive bitrate.
